pricing.mediaTextEditHelp: For media models, set only the text input/output rates in use, independently. Blank means unset, not zero. Without a fallback rate, pricing is shown as unverified.
pricing.mediaCacheEditHelp: Set only the text cache rates in use, independently. Clearing a rate unsets it; settlement may remain unresolved if that cache usage occurs in token billing. This differs from an explicit zero.
pricing.decimalError: Enter rates as non-negative decimal strings.
pricing.reservationError: Token billing requires a positive reservation cap for the whole request (USD).
pricing.variantLimit: You can set up to 500 image variant prices.
pricing.variantError: Image variants require unique size:quality values and non-negative USD / image rates.
pricing.basisHelp: Only the selected basis is used for execution charges. Token/tool fees are not automatically added to image, duration, character or session fees. Changing the basis or time unit does not delete other stored rates.
pricing.reservationHelp: USD · Positive maximum funds reservation, not a usage rate.
pricing.tokenBillingHelp: Settlement uses only actual provider token usage by modality. Without detailed usage, no estimated charge is made and reserved funds may remain unresolved. OpenAI TTS binary responses do not provide token usage and do not support token billing. Setting rates does not guarantee provider support or an execution route.
pricing.storedReservationHelp: USD · Used only for token billing
pricing.imageBaseHelp: USD / image · Used only for per-image billing
pricing.imageVariantHelp: The current per-image execution route requires exact size:quality variant rates (USD / image). A base rate alone does not enable execution; token billing uses a separate reservation cap.
pricing.sessionHelp: Settlement is made once using actual elapsed time of the provider-connected session, without rounding up to minutes. This differs from the sum of audio input/output duration. Funds are reserved for the maximum session duration. This setting does not add an execution route for unsupported models.
pricing.sessionRateHelp: USD / {unit} · Used only for session billing
pricing.storedTimeHelp: Existing values are kept · Explicitly clear values that conflict with other units. No automatic conversion.
pricing.characterRateHelp: USD / character · Used only for character billing
pricing.tokenRatesHelp: Token rates are in USD / 1M tokens. Blank means unset, not an explicit zero. Input, cached input and output are independent for each modality. Text rates are stored in separate existing columns.
pricing.modelDragging: Moving {name}. Drop above or below a card from the same provider.
pricing.modelOrderConflict: The list has changed or a model is running. Check the latest list before moving again.
pricing.modelOrderSaveFailed: Could not save the order{status}. Check the list before moving again.
pricing.modelReorderHelp: Drag cards up or down to reorder within the same provider. Dropping saves automatically. For keyboard or touch, use the card's move up/down buttons.
pricing.independentTextEditHelp: Text input and output rates are saved independently. Leave an unused direction blank. Clearing an existing value removes only that manual rate. Blank means unset and differs from an explicit zero. If no fallback rate exists, pricing is shown as unverified.
